Monitoring and Evaluation Interventions are evalu-
ated by measurement of speciﬁ c outcomes. Th ese include 
laboratory values such as: serum ferritin, TIBC, hemoglobin, 
hematocrit or transferrin saturation. Newer methods for the 
evaluation of iron status such as levels of the protein hepci-
din will become more available to practitioners over time.
Repeated evaluation of food and supplement documentation, 
such as patient food logs or prescribed supplement records, is
required.
